Name: Honey Harvest Predictor
Author: voltaek
Description:
The game decides which honey you receive from bee houses at time of harvest ([i]not[/i] when the honey is ready). This mod predicts what you'll harvest from it in the bubble above ready-for-harvest bee houses, so you know exactly what you'll get.

See demo GIFs and screenshot images (and their captions) for examples of functionality and compatibility.

[b]Note:[/b] This mod was formerly named [i]Honey Harvest Sync[/i].

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url]﻿[/size]
FULL - This is the main mod that compatibility has been integrated with, as it's the main beehouse improvement mod. All honey-producing crops, locations, conditions, and flower search ranges have been tested for full compatibility.

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30945]Colored Honey Labels[/url][/size]
FULL - The colored-label honey bottle icons work well with HHP in 'Honey' icon mode (see screenshot).

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22848]Better Honey Mead[/url]﻿[/size]
FULL - The only compatibility crossover is the honey bottle icons it provides when HHP is in 'Honey' icon mode, but that is confirmed working.

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url][/size]
FULL (when used with [i]Better Beehouses[/i]) - Its flower fruit trees, flower bushes, and flower crops are all compatible.

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23144]Neo's Giant Flowers[/url][/size]
FULL (when used with [i]Better Beehouses[/i]) - It's giant flowers are compatible.

[size=3]Other mods that add flowers[/size]
[list]
[*]For standard flower crops that the base game recognizes as flowers (they're in the flower category and/or have the context tag of 'flower_item') they should work automatically.
[*]For other flowers / honey flavor sources, the Better Beehouses mod is required. If you have that, then flower forage and any item with a 'honey_source' context tag will also be automatically recognized. The more "custom" flower plant types it supports such as fruit trees, bushes, and giant crops should also just work (as HHP has been written to be as flexible as possible), but if not compatibility may be able to be added (if you ask nicely).
[/list]
[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
You can change your options in the config.json file (created in this mod's folder after first run) or in-game via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Manager[/url].

[size=3]Options[/size]
[size=2][b]BeeHouseReadyIcon [/b]- Controls the type of icon that shows above your ready-for-harvest bee houses
[list]
[*]'Flower' (default) - Show the flower that will flavor your honey upon harvest
[*]'Honey' - Show the artisan honey that you'll receive upon harvest (requires custom artisan honey icons, see "Important" section below)
[/list][/size][size=3][b]Important[/b][/size]
This mod [b][u]does not[/u][/b] include any new artisan honey item icons in it. If you configure 'Honey' as the value for the 'BeeHouseReadyIcon' config option, you must have have another mod or mods installed that applies different icons for the various honey types.

For SD v1.6, the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30945]Colored Honey Labels[/url] is one such mod that provides honey bottle icons with labels colored based on the honey's flavor. Without a mod for honey icons, while this mod will keep the icon updated, the honey icon shown will always still be the generic/default one.


[size=4]SMAPI Console Commands[/size]
[size=2][list]
[*][b]hhp_refresh[/b] - Refreshes the mod's known ready-for-harvest bee houses or everything it's tracking, depending on options used. Should only be needed for testing or troubleshooting purposes. Run 'help hhp_refresh' in the SMAPI console for more info.
[/list][/size]
